scoring.success: outcome checks at the tool level, no listed tool-level must_not violated, no grounding violation, and for the outcomes without a write no listed reply-level flag (src/agent_eval/score.py)
scoring.targets: met when the 95% interval clears the target; a 100% or zero target needs no failure
scoring.reply_checks: heuristic flags for manual review (regular expressions and the ES/PT word scorer)

conservative_success.note: scenarios not scored count as failures
